title: [FMLA 21] Bernoulli — Bernoulli's Theorem
summary: Incompressible steady flow. The calculator prints C = v²/2 + gz + P/ρ (energy per unit mass), not the pressure-form constant.

body.text: Calculator scroll name: Bernoulli. For steady inviscid incompressible flow, height, speed, and pressure trade off. The ROM evaluates the energy-per-mass constant C, not the pressure-form sum P + ρgh + ½ρv².
For a steady incompressible flow, height, speed, and pressure trade off. Low and narrow → fast and lower P.

body.caption: The pipe drops and narrows. Fluid speeds up and pressure falls. The calculator reports C = v²/2 + gz + P/ρ, which stays the same along the flow.

body.text: Multiply through by density ρ to recover the textbook pressure form P + ρgz + ½ρv² (same physics; a different number on the display).
Primary inputs: v, z, ρ, P (that prompt order; height is z, not h).

body.title: How to run
items: Press FMLA, then 2, then 1 (or scroll to the name and EXE)
Display is C = v²/2 + gz + P/ρ, not P + ρgz + ½ρv²

body.label: CONST / g
body.text: The routine uses gravitational acceleration g from ROM. Keep v, z, ρ, and P in consistent SI units (m/s, m, kg/m³, Pa).
